title: Library review
duplicateCount: {count} song in total; nothing is deleted automatically. | {count} songs in total; nothing is deleted automatically.

mergePreview.summary: Keep “{kept}” and bring in the track order from “{retired}”.
mergePreview.keptHint: The original release, cover, notes and photos are kept; this can be undone.
mergePreview.movedObjects: Keeps {count} item from the other page. | Keeps {count} items from the other page.
mergePreview.tracks: {count} local song; audio files are unchanged. | {count} local songs; audio files are unchanged.

reasons.verified: Release members and current audio match; compare, then confirm the merge.
reasons.unverifiedMedia: Audio is missing, changed or unconfirmed, so these can't be merged yet.
reasons.differentSource: These come from different source releases, so each keeps its own track order and links.
reasons.differentTracklist: The release type or full track order differs, so these can't be merged yet.
reasons.assetConflict: Page items conflict; tidy up the notes or photos on both releases first.
reasons.assetLimit: Merged page items would exceed the limit; tidy up notes or photos first.

messages.busy: The audio is in use. Stop playback, preview or processing, then resume.
messages.conflict: Data changed. Check again, then confirm.
messages.stale: The library location changed. Check again.
messages.expired: This preview has expired. Check again.
messages.sourceMissing: The source doesn't have this field; keep the current value or enter it manually.
messages.invalidIntent: Some fields are incomplete or invalid. Check them and try again.
messages.recoveryRequired: The last write didn't finish. Resume the unfinished operation first.
messages.recoveryConflict: The data was changed and can't be recovered automatically; keep the current files.
messages.assetConflict: Page items on the two releases conflict; tidy them up and check again.
messages.assetLimit: Merged page items would exceed the limit; tidy them up and check again.
messages.limit: This is more data than can be handled at once; narrow it down and try again.
messages.failed: This can't be completed right now. Try again later.
messages.stopFailed: Can't stop right now. Try again later.
